fieldNotes.truckGate: Posted sign at the Miller Ave office entrance reads 'NO TRUCKS - TRUCKS USE ENTRANCE ON MEYER CANYON RD'; the truck yard is fully enclosed by chain-link/decorative wall perimeter fence, and trucks enter through a controlled pinch-point on the SW (Meyer Canyon Rd) side with median islands.
fieldNotes.guardShack: z19-z20 satellite shows a small booth/canopy structure (green-roofed) at the SW truck-yard entry checkpoint (~34.1105,-117.4827) separating employee parking from the secured yard; corroborated by driver reviews describing check-in with gate passes at the gate/shipping office.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large RDC; dock doors line the entire SW (west) face and the long south face with trailers backed in across both, easily 50+ (estimated ~140 total).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard wraps the building south/east plus a separate west drop yard; hundreds of parked trailers without tractors, far exceeding 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (long south face and west face) suggest separate ship/receive clusters - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and broad internal yard pavement leave ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the gate and the dock doors provides inside-gate holding; inferred from yard geometry.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Gate apron appears to support ~2 inbound lanes; exit lanes not separately confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the NE diagonal corridor is a separate utility/road right-of-way.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire industrial/residential fabric of Fontana - Urban.
